Project.NAME: yascheduler
Project.keywords: scheduler, SSH, cloud, HPC, AiiDA, orchestration
Project.annotation: Schedules scientific calculation jobs on SSH machines and cloud-created nodes.

M-MAIN.NAME: Package entry point
M-MAIN.purpose: Top-level package entry: re-exports Yascheduler client and path constants.

const-CONFIG_FILE.PURPOSE: Default config file path (re-exported via yascheduler.entrypoints)

const-PID_FILE.PURPOSE: Default PID file path (re-exported via yascheduler.entrypoints)

const-LOG_FILE.PURPOSE: Default log file path (re-exported via yascheduler.entrypoints)

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLIENT.NAME: Client API
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLIENT.purpose: Public Python/CLI client for submitting and querying tasks.
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLIENT.depends: M-APPLICATION, M-DOMAIN, M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG, M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-PARSER, M-DI, M-ENTRYPOINTS-PATHS

M-ENTRYPOINTS.NAME: Entrypoints layer facade
M-ENTRYPOINTS.purpose: Layer facade for the outermost hexagonal layer (driving adapters + composition root); re-exports Yascheduler from .client.

M-ENTRYPOINTS-PATHS.NAME: Entrypoints path constants
M-ENTRYPOINTS-PATHS.purpose: Process-global file-path constants (config, log, pid) consumed by the entrypoints layer.

M-CLIENT-SHIM.NAME: Client compat shim
M-CLIENT-SHIM.purpose: Compat shim re-exporting Yascheduler from yascheduler.entrypoints.client; preserves the deep import path from yascheduler.client import Yascheduler.

export-Yascheduler.PURPOSE: Compat re-export of Yascheduler from entrypoints.client

M-QUEUE.NAME: Unique queue
M-QUEUE.purpose: Deduplicating async queue for producer-consumer scheduling loops.

class-UniqueQueue.PURPOSE: Async queue that skips duplicate messages by ID

class-UMessage.PURPOSE: Typed message with ID and payload

M-AIIDA.NAME: AiiDA plugin
M-AIIDA.purpose: AiiDA scheduler plugin entry point for integrating with AiiDA workflows.

class-YaschedJobResource.PURPOSE: Resource class for yascheduler jobs in AiiDA

class-YaScheduler.PURPOSE: AiiDA Scheduler subclass for the yascheduler engine

M-CLI-COMMANDS.NAME: CLI commands package
M-CLI-COMMANDS.purpose: Per-command CLI adapter modules — parse args, call use cases via DI, format output.

CrossLink.relation: re-exports LogFormatter from shared/log.py

M-LOGGING.NAME: LogFormatter
M-LOGGING.purpose: LogFormatter rendering structured DEBUG trace records and user-facing records with distinct layouts.

class-LogFormatter.PURPOSE: Formatter with trace-record (extra-diff) and user-facing rendering branches

M-SHARED.NAME: Shared kernel
M-SHARED.purpose: Shared kernel: typing shims (Self, Unpack, StrEnum) and LogFormatter re-exported for cross-layer consumers.

M-SHARED-COMPAT.NAME: Shared compat shims
M-SHARED-COMPAT.purpose: Type compatibility shims: Self and Unpack re-exported from typing_extensions for older Python versions.

M-DAEMON-SYSTEMD.NAME: Systemd daemon
M-DAEMON-SYSTEMD.purpose: Systemd service entry point for the scheduler daemon.

M-DAEMON-SYSV.NAME: SysV daemon
M-DAEMON-SYSV.purpose: SysV init service entry point for launching the scheduler daemon.

fn-main.PURPOSE: SysV daemon entry point with DaemonContext

M-DAEMONIZE.NAME: Daemonize CLI command
M-DAEMONIZE.purpose: yascheduler CLI command — start the daemon in the foreground (manual/debug/container use) via the shared daemon core.

fn-daemonize.PURPOSE: argparse entry point: parse args and run the daemon in the foreground

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-ARGS.NAME: Shared CLI argparse helpers
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-ARGS.purpose: Shared argparse helpers for CLI entry points — existing_path validator and add_config_arg/add_log_level_arg/add_log_file_arg flag adders consumed by all six CLI commands and the three daemon launchers.

const-LOG_LEVEL_CHOICES.PURPOSE: Explicit list of accepted log-level names (no logging._levelToName private API)

M-DAEMON-COMMON.NAME: Shared daemon core
M-DAEMON-COMMON.purpose: Shared daemon core — configure_logger (root logger + backoff/asyncssh suppression + captureWarnings) and run_daemon (make_daemon + SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers + orch.start), consumed by all three daemon entry points.

fn-configure_logger.PURPOSE: Configure root logger with stderr handler, optional file handler, and library-noise suppression

fn-run_daemon.PURPOSE: Async daemon core: build orchestrator, register signal handlers, run start() with try/finally stop()

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-INIT.NAME: yainit CLI entry point
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-INIT.purpose: Bootstrap CLI command — install service unit files and/or apply DB schema + migrations with --schema/--daemon subset flags.

fn-init.PURPOSE: Service + schema + migrations initialization (--schema/--daemon subset selectors)

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-SHOW-NODES.NAME: yanodes CLI entry point
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-SHOW-NODES.purpose: List nodes and their running tasks with filter flags and table/JSON output.

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-SUBMIT.NAME: yasubmit CLI entry point
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-SUBMIT.purpose: yasubmit CLI command — parse AiiDA script, submit task via DI

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-MANAGE-NODE.NAME: yasetnode CLI entry point
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-MANAGE-NODE.purpose: yasetnode CLI command — add, soft-remove, or hard-remove nodes via UoW (+ SSH gateway on the add path)
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-MANAGE-NODE.depends: M-DOMAIN, M-ENTRYPOINTS, M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-PARSER, M-ADAPTERS, M-SSH-KEYS, M-SSH-REPOSITORY, M-PERSISTENCE-UOW

type-HostSpec.PURPOSE: Frozen parsed host spec (host, username, port, ncpus)

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-CHECK-STATUS.NAME: yastatus CLI entry point
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-CHECK-STATUS.purpose: Query and display task status with default/info/json/view renderers; verbose mode tails remote OUTPUT and optional convergence.
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CLI-CHECK-STATUS.depends: M-DOMAIN, M-ENTRYPOINTS, M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-PARSER, M-ADAPTERS, M-SSH-KEYS, M-SSH-REPOSITORY, M-PERSISTENCE-UOW

M-DOMAIN.NAME: Domain layer entry point
M-DOMAIN.purpose: Domain layer entry point — re-exports domain events, model entities, exception hierarchy, and port interfaces.
M-DOMAIN.depends: M-DOMAIN-ENGINE, M-DOMAIN-EVENTS, M-DOMAIN-EXCEPTIONS, M-DOMAIN-MODEL, M-DOMAIN-PORTS, M-DOMAIN-SETTINGS

M-DOMAIN-EXCEPTIONS.NAME: Domain exceptions
M-DOMAIN-EXCEPTIONS.purpose: Domain exception hierarchy for business-level error handling.

class-DomainError.PURPOSE: Base class for all domain exceptions

class-MissingInputFileError.PURPOSE: Required engine input file not provided

class-TaskNotTodoError.PURPOSE: Task not in TODO status (raised by run and reject)

class-TaskNotRunningError.PURPOSE: Task not in RUNNING status (raised by complete, fail, abandon)

class-MachineBusyError.PURPOSE: Operation attempted on a busy machine

class-NoCompatibleNodeError.PURPOSE: No matching node found for task

class-MachineConnectionError.PURPOSE: SSH connection failure carrying node_id, hostname, and reason

class-CloudError.PURPOSE: Cloud provider operational errors (base for CloudAllocateError/CloudSetupError)

class-CloudAllocateError.PURPOSE: Cloud node allocation error (subclass of CloudError)

class-CloudSetupError.PURPOSE: Cloud node setup error (SSH/cloud-init) (subclass of CloudError)

class-ProcessResult.PURPOSE: Exit code and captured output from remote execution

class-Engine.PURPOSE: Calculation engine specification with validate_inputs (re-exported from M-DOMAIN-ENGINE)

class-EngineRepository.PURPOSE: Frozen collection of engines (re-exported from M-DOMAIN-ENGINE)

type-NodeId.PURPOSE: Node primary-key value object (frozen dataclass wrapping int; validates >0; __str__ renders bare int; not equal to bare int)

M-DOMAIN-ENGINE.NAME: Engine domain types
M-DOMAIN-ENGINE.purpose: Engine value object, EngineRepository collection, Deploy strategies as frozen stdlib dataclasses.

class-Engine.PURPOSE: Calculation engine value object with validate_inputs

type-Deploy.PURPOSE: Union type of all deploy configurations

M-DOMAIN-PORTS.NAME: Domain ports
M-DOMAIN-PORTS.purpose: Domain port interfaces: abstract contracts for persistence, machine operations, and cloud provisioning.

class-MachineRepository.PURPOSE: Async port for the connected-machine collection

class-CloudConfig.PURPOSE: Structural Protocol for cloud provider config (8-field surface: prefix, max_nodes, idle_tolerance, connect_grace, username, jump_username, jump_host, jump_port)

type-connect_grace.PURPOSE: Per-cloud SSH connect-failure deadline in seconds (declared on CloudConfig Protocol + each ConfigCloud* DTO with provider-specific default)

M-DOMAIN-EVENTS.NAME: Domain events
M-DOMAIN-EVENTS.purpose: Domain events for task lifecycle transitions.

class-DomainEvent.PURPOSE: Base frozen dataclass with task_id: TaskId, webhook_url, webhook_custom_params

class-TaskAllocated.PURPOSE: Task assigned to node with node_id (NodeId) and engine_name

class-TaskAbandoned.PURPOSE: Task abandoned on lost node with node_id (NodeId)

type-Event.PURPOSE: Union type alias of all event types

fn-match_task_to_node.PURPOSE: Select first compatible free machine for a task, or None

M-APPLICATION.NAME: Application layer facade
M-APPLICATION.purpose: Application layer facade — sole public surface for cross-layer consumers and composition root.
M-APPLICATION.depends: M-APPLICATION-ABANDON-NODE, M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATION-TRACKER, M-APPLICATION-MESSAGE-BUS, M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR, M-APPLICATION-QUERY-TASKS, M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT, M-APPLICATION-UOW

M-APPLICATION-UOW.NAME: Abstract Unit of Work Protocol
M-APPLICATION-UOW.purpose: Protocol defining transactional boundary: tasks, nodes, commit, rollback, event dispatch.

class-AbstractUnitOfWork.PURPOSE: Async context manager Protocol with task and node repositories and event dispatch

M-APPLICATION-MESSAGE-BUS.NAME: Message bus
M-APPLICATION-MESSAGE-BUS.purpose: In-process message bus that dispatches domain events to registered handlers.

class-MessageBus.PURPOSE: Event dispatcher with type-based handler registry

M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT.NAME: Submit task use case
M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT.purpose: Validate engine/inputs, create domain Task, persist via UoW, record TaskCreated event.

fn-submit_task.PURPOSE: Create a new TO_DO task after validating engine and inputs

M-APPLICATION-QUERY-TASKS.NAME: Query tasks use case
M-APPLICATION-QUERY-TASKS.purpose: Read-only task query by statuses XOR job IDs within a single UoW; no commit. Returns tuple (tasks, nodes_by_id) after batch-loading allocated nodes.

fn-query_tasks.PURPOSE: Async read-only task query by statuses or job IDs via AbstractUnitOfWork; returns tuple[list[Task], dict[NodeId, Node]] — batch-loads nodes via uow.nodes.get_by_ids after fetching tasks, returns (tasks, {}) when all tasks unallocated

M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE.NAME: Allocate task use case
M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE.purpose: Match a TO_DO task to a free machine or request cloud provisioning (owns cloud-fallback flow: tracker dedup, capacity, tmp-node, final persist).
M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE.depends: M-DOMAIN, M-PERSISTENCE-UOW, M-SSH-REPOSITORY, M-SSH-OPS-OCCUPANCY, M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER, M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATION-TRACKER

fn-allocate_task.PURPOSE: Assign a TO_DO task to a free machine or own full cloud-fallback flow via CloudProvisioner port

M-APPLICATION-CONSUME.NAME: Consume task use case
M-APPLICATION-CONSUME.purpose: Download outputs from remote machine and finalise (DONE/DONE+error) or defer (stay RUNNING for retry) the task; returns bool finalisation signal.

fn-consume_task.PURPOSE: Download task outputs and finalise or defer for retry

M-APPLICATION-DEALLOCATE.NAME: Deallocate idle nodes use case
M-APPLICATION-DEALLOCATE.purpose: Disable idle cloud nodes and return Node objects for VM deletion.

fn-deallocate_node.PURPOSE: Per-node wrapper: gateway disconnect -> UoW disable+commit -> clouds.deallocate(node) -> UoW remove+commit

fn-deallocate_nodes.PURPOSE: Disable idle cloud nodes and return list[Node] (each carrying node_id) for orchestrator-level SSH disconnect + cloud deallocation (idle-disable sweep)

M-APPLICATION-ABANDON-NODE.NAME: Abandon never-connected node use case
M-APPLICATION-ABANDON-NODE.purpose: Clean up a cloud node that never established its SSH connection and discard the tracker entry linked to the node

fn-abandon_node.PURPOSE: Clean up never-connected cloud node + discard tracker entry by node (best-effort VM delete -> DB remove -> tracker.discard_by_node; warning if count>1)

M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATION-TRACKER.NAME: Allocation tracker
M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATION-TRACKER.purpose: In-memory dedup of in-flight cloud allocations by task_id with a task-to-node link; owned by orchestrator, injected into allocate/consume/abandon use cases.

class-AllocationTracker.PURPOSE: In-memory dict[TaskId, NodeId|None] tracking in-flight cloud allocations with a task-to-node link

fn-add.PURPOSE: Add a task_id with an optional node_id link; returns True if newly added, False if already tracked

fn-set_node.PURPOSE: Patch the node link into an existing tracker entry; no-op if untracked

fn-discard.PURPOSE: Remove a tracker entry by task_id; no-op if not present

fn-discard_by_node.PURPOSE: Remove all tracker entries linked to a node_id and return the count removed

M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR.NAME: Daemon Orchestrator
M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR.purpose: Manages producer-consumer loops calling use cases.
M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR.depends: M-DOMAIN, M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE, M-APPLICATION-CONSUME, M-APPLICATION-DEALLOCATE, M-APPLICATION-ABANDON-NODE, M-QUEUE, M-PERSISTENCE-UOW, M-SSH-REPOSITORY, M-SSH-OPS-DEPLOY, M-SSH-OPS-DOWNLOAD, M-SSH-OPS-OCCUPANCY, M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER

M-DI.NAME: Dependency Injection
M-DI.purpose: Composition root with factories per entry point: daemon, CLI. Wires MessageBus with webhook handlers; injects list_private_keys into the Orchestrator.
M-DI.depends: M-APPLICATION, M-DOMAIN, M-ADAPTERS, M-PERSISTENCE-UOW, M-SSH-REPOSITORY, M-SSH-OPS-DEPLOY, M-SSH-OPS-DOWNLOAD, M-SSH-OPS-OCCUPANCY, M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER, M-NOTIFIER-WEBHOOK, M-APPLICATION-MESSAGE-BUS, M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATION-TRACKER

class-CLIDeps.PURPOSE: Lightweight dependency container for CLI submit

fn-make_daemon.PURPOSE: Async factory creating Orchestrator with UoW factory (no DB, no auto-migration)

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-PARSER.NAME: INI config parser
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-PARSER.purpose: INI config parsing and assembly — parse_config assembles frozen Config aggregate.

fn-parse_config.PURPOSE: Public assembly: read INI, parse all sections, return frozen Config aggregate

fn-parse_engine_section.PURPOSE: Build a frozen Engine from a single [engine.*] INI section

fn-parse_engines.PURPOSE: Build an EngineRepository from all [engine.*] sections in a ConfigParser

fn-engine_valid_fields.PURPOSE: Return valid INI keys for an [engine.*] section

fn-parse_cloud_section.PURPOSE: Dispatch a [clouds] sub-section to its per-prefix parser via CLOUD_CONFIG_PARSERS

fn-parse_clouds.PURPOSE: Build the list of ConfigCloud DTOs from a [clouds] section, inheriting remote.username for missing prefix users

fn-cloud_valid_fields.PURPOSE: Return valid INI keys for a given cloud prefix (dataclass fields + aliases, minus excludes)

const-CLOUD_CONFIG_PARSERS.PURPOSE: Registry mapping cloud provider prefix -> per-prefix parser callable (open/closed seam for adding providers)

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-UTILS.NAME: Config parser helpers
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG-UTILS.purpose: Parser-side config helpers — warning for unknown INI keys and optional-string coercion.

class-ConfigWarning.PURPOSE: Warning emitted for unknown INI keys

fn-warn_unknown_fields.PURPOSE: Emit ConfigWarning for keys outside the valid set

fn-opt_str_val.PURPOSE: Coerce a ConfigParser value to an optional string

M-PERSISTENCE.NAME: Persistence subpackage facade (internal)
M-PERSISTENCE.purpose: Persistence subpackage facade — internal organization of the adapters layer; re-exported by M-ADAPTERS for cross-layer consumers and composition root.

export-apply_schema.PURPOSE: Apply schema.sql in a transactional block

export-PostgresUnitOfWork.PURPOSE: Concrete UoW backed by Postgres (consumed by composition root)

M-PERSISTENCE-SQLLOADER.NAME: SQL query loader
M-PERSISTENCE-SQLLOADER.purpose: SQL query file loader — reads .sql files with @functools.cache for pg8000 repositories.

fn-load_query.PURPOSE: Load SQL file contents by name with lru_cache

M-PERSISTENCE-EXCEPTIONS.NAME: Persistence exceptions
M-PERSISTENCE-EXCEPTIONS.purpose: Adapter-layer exceptions for persistence UoW state-contract violations and repository row-existence precondition violations.

class-UnitOfWorkNotInitializedError.PURPOSE: Raised when UoW methods called without entering context

class-TaskRowNotFoundError.PURPOSE: Raised by PostgresTaskRepository.save/update_status when an UPDATE targets a non-existent task_id

M-PERSISTENCE-POSTGRES.NAME: PostgreSQL repositories
M-PERSISTENCE-POSTGRES.purpose: PostgresTaskRepository and PostgresNodeRepository implementing domain repository ports via pg8000.

M-PERSISTENCE-UOW.NAME: PostgreSQL Unit of Work
M-PERSISTENCE-UOW.purpose: PostgresUnitOfWork managing shared pg8000 Connection across repositories with commit/rollback and event dispatch.

class-PostgresUnitOfWork.PURPOSE: Async context manager for transactional boundaries with shared connection and event dispatch

M-PERSISTENCE-SCHEMA.NAME: Schema applier
M-PERSISTENCE-SCHEMA.purpose: Synchronous transactional application of schema.sql via pg8000 for CLI init and test fixtures

fn-apply_schema.PURPOSE: Apply schema.sql in BEGIN/COMMIT transaction, rollback on failure; the schema text bootstraps yascheduler_migrations via a DO block

fn-apply_migrations.PURPOSE: Apply pending migrations from sql/migrations/ to the DB behind config

M-PERSISTENCE-MIGRATION-BASE.NAME: Migration base class
M-PERSISTENCE-MIGRATION-BASE.purpose: Migration base class for .py migrations — injected (config, conn, log) with begin/commit helpers for non-transactional operations (CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, VACUUM) and migrate raising NotImplementedError.

M-DOMAIN-SETTINGS.NAME: Domain settings
M-DOMAIN-SETTINGS.purpose: Cross-layer application settings as frozen stdlib dataclasses — local daemon config and remote SSH defaults; no INI parsing on the DTOs.

class-LocalSettings.PURPOSE: Frozen dataclass: daemon data paths, webhook, concurrency limits; __post_init__ validates ge(1)/ge(0)

class-RemoteDefaults.PURPOSE: Frozen dataclass: remote SSH paths, username, jump host, jump_port

M-INFRA-DB-CONFIG.NAME: Postgres DB config
M-INFRA-DB-CONFIG.purpose: PostgreSQL connection configuration as a frozen stdlib dataclass; no INI parsing on the DTO.

class-PostgresDbConfig.PURPOSE: Frozen dataclass: PostgreSQL connection params (user/password/database/host/port); __post_init__ validates port ge(1)

M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG.NAME: Config aggregate
M-ENTRYPOINTS-CONFIG.purpose: Composition-root config aggregate bundling settings from all inner layers for delivery to the orchestrator and CLIs; only entrypoints consumes it.

class-Config.PURPOSE: Frozen dataclass: composition-root aggregate (db, local, remote, clouds, engines); importable from yascheduler.entrypoints

M-CLOUD-CONFIGS.NAME: Cloud config DTOs
M-CLOUD-CONFIGS.purpose: Cloud provider config DTOs and the ConfigCloud union — frozen stdlib dataclasses relocated from yascheduler.config.cloud.

class-ConfigCloudAzure.PURPOSE: Azure cloud config frozen dataclass; explicitly inherits domain CloudConfig Protocol

class-ConfigCloudHetzner.PURPOSE: Hetzner cloud config frozen dataclass; explicitly inherits domain CloudConfig Protocol

class-ConfigCloudUpcloud.PURPOSE: Upcloud cloud config frozen dataclass; explicitly inherits domain CloudConfig Protocol

class-ConfigCloudVastAI.PURPOSE: VastAI cloud config frozen dataclass; explicitly inherits domain CloudConfig Protocol

class-AzureImageReference.PURPOSE: Azure VM image URN with from_urn pure parser

type-ConfigCloud.PURPOSE: Union of all cloud config DTO types

type-package_upgrade.PURPOSE: cloud-init package_upgrade flag, default True; declared on all 4 ConfigCloud* DTOs (infra-only, NOT on the CloudConfig Protocol), sources CloudInitConfig.package_upgrade via CloudProvisionerImpl._get_cloud_config_data(config).package_upgrade

type-jump_port.PURPOSE: SSH port of the provider's bastion/jump host leg, default 22; declared on all 4 ConfigCloud* DTOs AND on the CloudConfig Protocol (8th field) because the cloud allocator stamps it onto Node.jump_port alongside jump_host/jump_username

M-ADAPTERS.NAME: Adapters layer facade
M-ADAPTERS.purpose: Adapters layer facade — sole public surface for cross-layer consumers (application, composition root). Re-exports gateway, retry exceptions, cloud provisioner, schema/migration initializers, and webhook handler.

export-TaskDeployer.PURPOSE: Upload inputs and spawn calculation process

export-OutputDownloader.PURPOSE: Per-file SFTP-isolated download with retry and error classification

export-AllSSHRetryExc.PURPOSE: Tuple of all retryable SSH exceptions

export-apply_schema.PURPOSE: Apply schema.sql in a transactional block (yainit / test fixtures)

export-apply_migrations.PURPOSE: Apply pending .sql/.py migrations from sql/migrations/ (yainit / test fixtures)

M-CLOUD.NAME: Cloud subpackage facade (internal)
M-CLOUD.purpose: Cloud subpackage facade — internal organization of the adapters layer; re-exported by M-ADAPTERS for cross-layer consumers.
M-CLOUD.depends: M-CLOUD-ADAPTERS-NEW, M-CLOUD-CONFIGS, M-CLOUD-INIT, M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS, M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER, M-CLOUD-SSH-KEYS, M-CLOUD-UTILS

export-CreateNodeCallable.PURPOSE: Create node in the cloud protocol

export-DeleteNodeCallable.PURPOSE: Delete node in the cloud protocol

export-AzureImageReference.PURPOSE: Azure VM image URN reference (re-exported from .cloud_configs; consumed by provider modules under TYPE_CHECKING)

export-ConfigCloud.PURPOSE: Union of cloud config DTO types (re-exported from .cloud_configs)

export-resolve_adapter.PURPOSE: Look up cloud adapter by prefix from registry

M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER.NAME: Cloud provisioner
M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER.purpose: CloudProvisionerImpl — pure cloud-API adapter implementing CloudProvisioner port (create/delete VM, setup, SSH keys); no DB access.
M-CLOUD-PROVISIONER.depends: M-DOMAIN, M-DOMAIN-SETTINGS, M-SSH-KEYS, M-SSH-REPOSITORY, M-SSH-SESSION, M-CLOUD-CONFIGS, M-CLOUD-INIT, M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-SELECTION, M-CLOUD-SSH-KEYS

class-CloudProvisionerImpl.PURPOSE: Concrete CloudProvisioner port adapter; allocate(provider, node: Node)->Node (derives the identity via replace on the passed node after create_node — no fresh Node construction; reuses node.node_id, single-row UPDATE lifecycle), deallocate(node: Node) (reads node.cloud/node.hostname internally, no-ops on cloud is None), select_provider

class-CloudAllocateError.PURPOSE: Cloud allocation failure (domain exception realized via yascheduler.domain)

class-CloudSetupError.PURPOSE: Cloud setup/bootstrap failure (domain exception realized via yascheduler.domain)

M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-SELECTION.NAME: Provider selection
M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-SELECTION.purpose: Pure function selecting best cloud provider by priority, capacity, and platform support.

fn-select_provider_pure.PURPOSE: Pick highest-priority provider with capacity and platform support; called only from CloudProvisionerImpl.select_provider

M-CLOUD-PROVIDERS.NAME: Cloud providers facade
M-CLOUD-PROVIDERS.purpose: Providers subpackage facade — re-exports provider create/delete callables.

M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-AZ.NAME: Azure provider
M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-AZ.purpose: Azure VM creation and deletion using Azure SDK.

fn-az_create_node.PURPOSE: Create Azure VM via Azure SDK

fn-az_delete_node.PURPOSE: Delete Azure VM via Azure SDK

M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-HETZNER.NAME: Hetzner provider
M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-HETZNER.purpose: Hetzner Cloud server creation and deletion via API.

M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-UPCLOUD.NAME: UpCloud provider
M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-UPCLOUD.purpose: UpCloud server creation and deletion via API.

M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-VASTAI.NAME: VastAI provider
M-CLOUD-PROVIDER-VASTAI.purpose: VastAI GPU marketplace instance creation and deletion via REST API.

M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS.NAME: Cloud protocols
M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS.purpose: Protocol definitions for node creation and deletion callables.

M-CLOUD-INIT.NAME: Cloud-init renderer dataclass
M-CLOUD-INIT.purpose: CloudInitConfig — the concrete cloud-init user-data renderer (bootcmd, packages, package_upgrade, render, render_base64).

M-CLOUD-ADAPTERS-NEW.NAME: Cloud adapter factory
M-CLOUD-ADAPTERS-NEW.purpose: CloudAdapter class and adapter factory functions for provider registration.

const-CLOUD_ADAPTER_GETTERS.PURPOSE: Registry mapping cloud prefix to adapter factory

fn-resolve_adapter.PURPOSE: Look up cloud adapter by prefix from registry (public; consumed by composition root)

M-CLOUD-SSH-KEYS.NAME: SSH key management
M-CLOUD-SSH-KEYS.purpose: SSH key generation, loading, and name extraction for cloud provisioning.

fn-get_or_create_ssh_key.PURPOSE: Load existing SSH key or generate a new one

M-NOTIFIER.NAME: Notifier subpackage facade (internal)
M-NOTIFIER.purpose: Notifier subpackage facade — re-exports webhook_handler as public surface for the adapters layer facade.

export-webhook_handler.PURPOSE: Async webhook event handler dispatching domain events to configured endpoint

M-NOTIFIER-WEBHOOK.NAME: Webhook notifier
M-NOTIFIER-WEBHOOK.purpose: Webhook event handler that sends HTTP notifications for task lifecycle events.

fn-webhook_handler.PURPOSE: Async handler that sends webhooks for task lifecycle events

M-SSH.NAME: SSH subpackage facade (internal)
M-SSH.purpose: SSH subpackage facade — internal organization of the adapters layer; re-exports repository, session, operations, and retry exceptions for the M-ADAPTERS layer facade.

export-TaskDeployer.PURPOSE: Upload inputs and spawn calculation process

export-OutputDownloader.PURPOSE: Per-file SFTP-isolated download with retry and error classification

export-AllSSHRetryExc.PURPOSE: Tuple of all retryable SSH exceptions

M-SSH-SESSION.NAME: SSH machine session
M-SSH-SESSION.purpose: SSHMachineSession — concrete connected-machine entity handle: domain identity (hostname, mutable machine snapshot, is_closed, occupy/release/update), connect-time config (adapter, platforms, data_dir, engines_dir, tasks_dir), adapter-derived accessors (path, quote, hostname), base SSH primitives (run/run_full/run_bg/upload/open_sftp/get_cpu_cores/setup_node/pgrep/list_processes), and the per-session monitor mechanism (install_monitor/cancel_monitor) with self-owned teardown (_close). Implements the MachineSession Protocol. Owns my_backoff_exc canonical partial.

type-MachineSession.PURPOSE: Domain Protocol for the connected-machine entity handle

M-SSH-REPOSITORY.NAME: SSH machine repository
M-SSH-REPOSITORY.purpose: SSHMachineRepository — connected-machine collection: registration, lifecycle, queries. Implements the MachineRepository Protocol.

class-SSHMachineRepository.PURPOSE: Concrete MachineRepository port implementation owning _sessions; connect reads jump-leg identity (jump_host/jump_port/jump_username) from node — no jump kwargs in signature

class-MySSHClient.PURPOSE: Insecure SSH client trusting all host keys (connection-building bit; stays)

const-DEFAULT_CONN_OPTS.PURPOSE: Default SSH connection options (connection-building bit; stays)

fn-connect.PURPOSE: Open SSH connection and register MachineSession under node.node_id; jump-leg identity read from node.* fields (not passed as kwargs)

M-SSH-OPERATIONS.NAME: SSH machine operations
M-SSH-OPERATIONS.depends: M-SSH-SESSION, M-PLATFORM, M-PLATFORM-PROTOCOL, M-DOMAIN, M-DOMAIN-ENGINE, M-SSH-OPS-DEPLOY, M-SSH-OPS-DOWNLOAD, M-SSH-OPS-OCCUPANCY

M-SSH-OPS-DEPLOY.NAME: Task deployer
M-SSH-OPS-DEPLOY.purpose: TaskDeployer — upload task inputs and spawn the calculation process on a remote machine via MachineSession primitives; rolls back session BUSY on failure.

class-TaskDeployer.PURPOSE: Upload task inputs and spawn calculation process; stateless (takes log); rolls back session BUSY on failure

fn-start_task_on_machine.PURPOSE: Upload inputs and spawn process; checks session.is_closed in rollback (already-disconnected warning); rolls back via session.update(session.machine.release)

M-SSH-OPS-DOWNLOAD.NAME: Output downloader
M-SSH-OPS-DOWNLOAD.purpose: OutputDownloader — per-file SFTP-isolated download with retry, error classification, conservative post-loop rmtree. Operates on a MachineSession; stateless.

class-OutputDownloader.PURPOSE: Per-file SFTP-isolated download with retry and error classification

fn-download_outputs.PURPOSE: Per-file SFTP-isolated download via session.open_sftp/session.path with retry, error classification, conservative post-loop rmtree

fn-my_backoff_sftp.PURPOSE: Partial backoff decorator for SFTPRetryExc (canonical; first user is download_outputs)

M-SSH-OPS-OCCUPANCY.NAME: Occupancy checker
M-SSH-OPS-OCCUPANCY.purpose: OccupancyChecker — pgrep/cmd-based occupancy check logic + monitor installer composing the session's monitor mechanism. Operates on a MachineSession; stateless.

class-OccupancyChecker.PURPOSE: Occupancy check via pgrep or check_cmd; start_occupancy_check composes session.install_monitor; stateless (takes log)

fn-occupancy_check.PURPOSE: Check if engine process is still running via session.pgrep or session.run_full on check_cmd

fn-start_occupancy_check.PURPOSE: Call session.occupy if FREE then session.install_monitor(...); check_factory awaits occupancy_check; on_free=session.release

M-PLATFORM-REGISTRY.NAME: Platform adapter registry
M-PLATFORM-REGISTRY.purpose: Ordered platform adapter registry for platform detection (ADAPTERS).

const-ADAPTERS.PURPOSE: Ordered platform adapter instances (debian, linux, darwin, windows variants)

M-PLATFORM-DETECT.NAME: Platform detection
M-PLATFORM-DETECT.purpose: Platform detection — run adapter checks on a connected host, return first match and all matched platforms.

M-PLATFORM-PATHS.NAME: Platform path normalization
M-PLATFORM-PATHS.purpose: Normalize remote data/engines/tasks dirs using the adapter's path type.

M-PLATFORM-RUN-FN.NAME: Platform run-fn closure
M-PLATFORM-RUN-FN.purpose: Pure closure binding conn + adapter.quote into an OuterRunCallable for adapter.get_cpu_cores / setup_node.

fn-make_run_fn.PURPOSE: Build OuterRunCallable with pre-bound conn and adapter.quote (extracted from gateway._make_run_fn, renamed public)

M-PLATFORM.NAME: SSH platform package root
M-PLATFORM.purpose: Platform detection and OS-specific command adapters for SSH-connected machines; re-export hub for the platform submodules, including the detection registry/symbols migrated from the dissolved helpers.py.
M-PLATFORM.depends: M-PLATFORM-ADAPTERS, M-PLATFORM-CHECKS, M-PLATFORM-COMMON, M-PLATFORM-DETECT, M-PLATFORM-EXC, M-PLATFORM-LINUX, M-PLATFORM-PATHS, M-PLATFORM-PROTOCOL, M-PLATFORM-REGISTRY, M-PLATFORM-RUN-FN, M-PLATFORM-WINDOWS

M-PLATFORM-ADAPTERS.NAME: Platform adapters
M-PLATFORM-ADAPTERS.purpose: Platform-specific adapter registry mapping OS identifiers to adapter instances.

M-PLATFORM-CHECKS.NAME: Platform checks
M-PLATFORM-CHECKS.purpose: SSH-based platform detection check functions for each supported OS.

fn-check_is_linux.PURPOSE: Check if remote is generic Linux via uname

fn-check_is_darwin.PURPOSE: Check if remote is Darwin/macOS via uname

fn-check_is_debian_like.PURPOSE: Check if remote is Debian-like via os-release

fn-check_is_windows.PURPOSE: Check if remote runs Windows with PowerShell

M-PLATFORM-COMMON.NAME: Platform common
M-PLATFORM-COMMON.purpose: Shared helpers for remote machine operations: command execution.

fn-run.PURPOSE: Run process on SSH connection and wait for exit

fn-run_bg.PURPOSE: Create background process on SSH connection

M-PLATFORM-EXC.NAME: Platform exceptions
M-PLATFORM-EXC.purpose: Custom exceptions for remote machine operations.

class-PlatformGuessFailedError.PURPOSE: Raised when no adapter matches detected platform

M-PLATFORM-LINUX.NAME: Linux methods
M-PLATFORM-LINUX.purpose: Linux-specific remote commands: package install, process listing, CPU detection.

fn-linux_setup_node.PURPOSE: Install packages and setup engines on Linux

fn-linux_list_processes.PURPOSE: Parse ps output into process info

M-PLATFORM-WINDOWS.NAME: Windows methods
M-PLATFORM-WINDOWS.purpose: Windows-specific remote commands: engine deployment, process listing.

fn-windows_setup_node.PURPOSE: Install packages and setup engines on Windows

fn-windows_list_processes.PURPOSE: Parse Get-CimInstance output into process info

M-PLATFORM-PROTOCOL.NAME: Platform protocols
M-PLATFORM-PROTOCOL.purpose: Protocol definitions for process info, SSH checks, and adapters.

class-ProcessInfo.PURPOSE: Frozen dataclass holding pid, name, command for a remote process

type-AllSSHRetryExc.PURPOSE: Union of all retryable SSH exceptions

M-SSH-KEYS.NAME: SSH key discovery
M-SSH-KEYS.purpose: Pure-function SSH private-key discovery from a keys directory; consumed by the orchestrator (injected callable), cloud provisioner, and node-management CLI.

fn-list_private_keys.PURPOSE: List private-key file paths from a keys directory (pure function)
